svg.title: NullLab layered architecture
svg.desc: Inputs feed a planner model, a plain-code guard checks the plan, a network-off sandbox re-runs four configurations over three seeds, statistics compute inflation with intervals, a trace is stored, and the report and demo page read the trace. Model boxes are marked.

g.text: claim excerpt + train.py + data.csv. Truth files and published numbers are never in the view.
names suspect steps, predicts drop, writes edits
5 fixed rules tried before any model call
edit stays in its step; no feature/model/metric change; forecast needs a time split; (G9) behavioural row check
4 SANDBOX [plain code, network off, no model]
original, fix A, fix B, both x seeds 42/43/44 (restricted subprocess, not a container)
claimed - controlled; unpaired bootstrap 95% interval per seed
plan, patches, events, replies (no keys), hashes
verdict FALSIFIED / SURVIVED / INCONCLUSIVE; reviewer report; CI exit code; bundle; .patch; demo page (no model call)

svg.text: Reading-only baseline B3 (one Spark prompt, no execution) runs beside this stack for comparison. Wonder is a swappable planner (small probe only).
